name: loka-wikidata-v13
notes: Third rung of the normalized-wikidata series, trained on the v13-500k corpus (2,511,771 clean labeled triples, 3.7x v12's size). Same 44.5M-parameter BPE architecture. Per-epoch trajectory: epoch 1 ppl 334.76 (epoch 1 is much stronger than v11's 6577 or v12's 1334 — bigger corpus = stronger first-epoch gradient signal), epoch 2 ppl 242.75 (best), then plateau drift 248.29 -> 258.42 -> 256.04 over epochs 3-5. The drift is classic Adam-momentum plateau behaviour on an exclusive 80W-capped laptop GPU (verified via nvidia-smi: 74W actual, 74C, 83% GPU util, no contention) — not the v12-style multi-rail divergence. Per-epoch snapshots tagged v13.1 through v13.5 on HF; the canonical v13 is the epoch-2 ckpt at ppl 242.75. Future contributor runs with larger batch sizes (24GB+ VRAM) may find a deeper basin — see pages/contribute/index.html for the hardware-constraint rationale. Companion dataset: EmmaLeonhart/normalized-wikidata tag v13-500k. v14 partial-local training (5 epochs on the 4M-triple v14-1M corpus) started in parallel.
